reconcile.note: Fausset and his JFB colleagues read testing revelation as exercising reasoned private judgment, still submitted to Scripture rather than replacing it with autonomous certainty.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells's Skeptic's Annotated Bible reads Proverbs' warning against leaning on one's own understanding as flatly incompatible with the command to test and prove all things.

sides.snippet: Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, And don't lean on your own understanding.
sides.verseText: Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, And don't lean on your own understanding.

sides.snippet: Test all things, and hold firmly that which is good.
sides.verseText: Test all things, and hold firmly that which is good.
